description: This file provides JWT authentication and authorization utilities for a FastAPI application, including dependencies for getting current, active, and superuser admin users, as well as optional authentication.

methods.name: Admin get_current_user( credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Dependency to retrieve the current authenticated admin user based on JWT token.

methods.name: Admin get_current_active_user( current_user: Admin = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Dependency to retrieve the current active admin user.

methods.name: Admin get_current_superuser( current_user: Admin = Depends(get_current_active_user) )
methods.description: Dependency to retrieve the current superuser admin user.

methods.name: Optional[Admin] optional_auth( credentials: Optional[HTTPAuthorizationCredentials] = Depends(security), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Optional authentication dependency allowing both authenticated and anonymous access.
